result.instructions: Tools for Cliniko, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my appointments for tomorrow and who they are with."; "What is the next open appointment slot with my first practitioner?"; "Show invoices for patient Jane Smith with their payment details.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cliniko data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cliniko_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cliniko_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cliniko_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cliniko_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cliniko_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the Cliniko account and subscription details for the authenticated API key. A good first call to sanity-check auth, shard, and User-Agent. GET /account.

tools.name: cliniko_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: Search/list patients. Name/email filters use Cliniko 'contains' matching (q[]=field:~value). GET /patients.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Fetch a single patient by id. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List individual appointments, optionally filtered by patient/practitioner/business/type and a starts_at window (starts_from / starts_to: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, or YYYY-MM-DD = 00:00 UTC; sent to Cliniko in UTC). GET /individual_appointments.

starts_from.description: Only appointments starting at/after this time (q[]=starts_at:>=). ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, or YYYY-MM-DD.

starts_to.description: Only appointments starting before this time (q[]=starts_at:<). ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, or YYYY-MM-DD.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_list_treatment_notes
tools.title: List treatment notes
tools.description: List treatment notes, optionally filtered by patient. NOTE: treatment notes are protected health information (PHI) — handle with care. Read-only. GET /treatment_notes.

tools.name: cliniko_get_treatment_note
tools.title: Get a treatment note
tools.description: Fetch a single treatment note by id. NOTE: treatment notes are protected health information (PHI). Read-only. GET /treatment_notes/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_available_times
tools.title: List available times
tools.description: List bookable appointment slots for a business + practitioner + appointment type within a date range (from/to, yyyy-mm-dd, span <= 7 days). High-value booking-slot lookup. GET /businesses/{business_id}/practitioners/{practitioner_id}/appointment_types/{appointment_type_id}/available_times.

from.description: Range start yyyy-mm-dd (cannot be more than 7 days before `to`).

to.description: Range end yyyy-mm-dd (cannot be more than 7 days after `from`).

tools.name: cliniko_next_available_time
tools.title: Next available time
tools.description: Get the single next bookable slot for a business + practitioner + appointment type (optionally from a date). GET /businesses/{business_id}/practitioners/{practitioner_id}/appointment_types/{appointment_type_id}/next_available_time.

from.description: Optional earliest date yyyy-mm-dd to search from.

tools.name: cliniko_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: WRITE — creates a REAL new patient record in the live Cliniko practice. Requires first_name + last_name. POST /patients.

phone_number.description: A phone number (stored as a Mobile phone number).

tools.name: cliniko_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: WRITE — books a REAL new individual appointment in the live Cliniko practice. Requires patient_id, practitioner_id, business_id, appointment_type_id, and starts_at (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; sent in UTC). ends_at defaults from the appointment type if omitted. To hold time without a patient (a room block, lunch, leave), use cliniko_create_unavailable_block instead. POST /individual_appointments.

ends_at.description: End time, ISO 8601. Defaults from the appointment type if omitted.

tools.name: cliniko_list_unavailable_block_types
tools.title: List unavailable block types
tools.description: List the practice's unavailable block types (e.g. Room Block, Lunch, Leave) with id, name, colour and default duration. Use the id as unavailable_block_type_id in cliniko_create_unavailable_block. GET /unavailable_block_types.

tools.name: cliniko_list_unavailable_blocks
tools.title: List unavailable blocks
tools.description: List unavailable blocks (diary time held without a patient: room blocks, lunch, leave), optionally filtered by business, practitioner, block type and a starts_at window (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, or YYYY-MM-DD = 00:00 UTC). Archived blocks are excluded. GET /unavailable_blocks.

unavailable_block_type_id.description: Filter by unavailable block type id.

starts_from.description: Only blocks starting at/after this time (q[]=starts_at:>=).

starts_to.description: Only blocks starting before this time (q[]=starts_at:<).

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_create_unavailable_block
tools.title: Create an unavailable block
tools.description: WRITE — holds REAL diary time in the live Cliniko practice without a patient: a room block, lunch, leave or meeting. No patient_id. Requires business_id, practitioner_id (the diary column to block), starts_at and ends_at (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; sent in UTC). Set unavailable_block_type_id (from cliniko_list_unavailable_block_types, e.g. the Room Block type) and put the room or reason in notes. repeat_rule repeats the block. Undo with cliniko_archive_unavailable_block. POST /unavailable_blocks.

practitioner_id.description: Practitioner id whose diary is blocked (required).

starts_at.description: Start, ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, e.g. 2026-11-10T09:00:00+11:00 (required).

ends_at.description: End, ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; after starts_at (required).

unavailable_block_type_id.description: Unavailable block type id, e.g. the practice's Room Block type.

notes.description: Notes shown on the block, e.g. the room held ("Room 833").

repeat_rule.description: Optional repeat, e.g. { repeat_type: Weekly, repeating_interval: 1, number_of_repeats: 11 } for 12 weekly blocks.

repeating_interval.description: Repeat every N days/weeks/months (1 = every; at most 100).

number_of_repeats.description: How many more times the block repeats after the first.

tools.name: cliniko_archive_unavailable_block
tools.title: Archive an unavailable block
tools.description: WRITE — archives (removes from the diary) one REAL unavailable block in the live Cliniko practice, e.g. to undo a block created by mistake. POST /unavailable_blocks/{id}/archive.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cliniko
prompts.description: What you can do with Cliniko here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_appointment_slots_for_a_practitioner
prompts.title: Find open appointment slots for a practitioner
prompts.description: The AI lists bookable slots for a business, practitioner and appointment type within a date range of up to 7 days. You can see when the practitioner has openings.

prompts.name: get_the_next_available_time_for_a_service
prompts.title: Get the next available time for a service
prompts.description: The AI looks up the single next bookable slot for a business, practitioner and appointment type, from a date you give. It answers when the next opening is.

prompts.name: list_your_practice_locations_and_practitioners
prompts.title: List your practice locations and practitioners
prompts.description: The AI lists the businesses (practice locations) and practitioners in the account. You get an overview of who works in the practice and where.

prompts.name: review_the_services_and_products_you_bill
prompts.title: Review the services and products you bill
prompts.description: The AI lists the appointment types (service definitions) and the billable products and items. You can check what the practice offers and sells.

prompts.name: check_the_cliniko_account_and_subscription_details
prompts.title: Check the Cliniko account and subscription details
prompts.description: The AI reads the account and subscription details for the API key. It is a quick way to confirm the connection works before other tasks.
